---
title: "SpatialBench"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

# pkgdown renders an article from the directory it lives in
root <- if (file.exists("bench/setup.R")) "." else "../.."
last_run <- file.path(root, "bench", "last-run")

timings <- read.csv(file.path(last_run, "timings.csv"))
machine <- read.csv(file.path(last_run, "machine.csv"))

queries <- sprintf("bench/q%d.R", seq_len(nrow(timings)))
files <- c(
  "Shared setup" = "bench/setup.R",
  stats::setNames(queries, paste("Query", seq_along(queries)))
)
```

The twelve queries of
[SpatialBench](https://github.com/apache/sedona-spatialbench), run by
`bench/run-all.R` and read back here from `bench/last-run/`.

```{r}
knitr::kable(t(machine), col.names = "")
knitr::kable(timings)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis

# the accordion of https://pkg.garrickadenbuie.com/quarto-panel-accordion,
# written out rather than filtered in: that extension steps aside unless quarto
# supplies bootstrap itself, and pkgdown renders with `theme: none` because the
# site template brings its own. Divs rather than raw html throughout, so the
# code blocks inside still reach pandoc and get highlighted.
accordion <- "bench-accordion"
fence <- strrep("`", 3)

cat("\n:::::: {.accordion #", accordion, "}\n\n", sep = "")

for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  id <- paste0(accordion, "-", i)
  path <- files[[i]]

  cat("::::: {.accordion-item}\n\n")
  cat('<h3 class="accordion-header">\n')
  cat(
    '<button class="accordion-button collapsed" type="button" ',
    'data-bs-toggle="collapse" data-bs-target="#', id, '" ',
    'aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="', id, '">',
    names(files)[[i]],
    "</button>\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat("</h3>\n\n")

  cat(
    ":::: {#", id, " .accordion-collapse .collapse ",
    'data-bs-parent="#', accordion, '"}\n\n',
    sep = ""
  )
  cat("::: {.accordion-body}\n\n")
  cat(fence, '{.r filename="', path, '"}\n', sep = "")
  cat(readLines(file.path(root, path)), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n", fence, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(":::\n\n::::\n\n:::::\n\n")
}

cat("::::::\n")
```
